translations.web: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.
translations.bsb: and after everyone had finished crossing, the priests with the ark of the LORD crossed in the sight of the people.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of Jehovah passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
